turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Maya, an AI assistant calling from Northgate Lettings about the enquiry you made on our website. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes. I'm a full-time student, is that a problem?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Not a problem, but for full-time students we do need a guarantor. They need to be UK based and earn at least thirty six times the monthly rent a year.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My dad could be my guarantor, he works full time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That should work. He would sign a separate deed of guarantee. Would you like to book a viewing first?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Friday at four is booked. I'll text you the confirmation and a list of the documents you and your dad will need.
